title: Bharathan
desc: Upon being falsely incriminated for his older brother's murder, Bharath plots revenge against a powerful businessman with the help of three convicts.

title: Sri Bannari Amman
desc: Goddess Bannari Amman takes the form of a skilled healer, travelling through small villages to cure people's ailments. On her divine mission, she vanquishes evil and blesses the righteous.

title: Udhiri Pookkal
desc: Vadivelu is a sadist who never respects the feelings of his children and wife. When his plan to marry his wife's sister fails, he accuses his wife of having an affair with the health inspector.

title: Girivalam
desc: Priya loves Arjun, the leader of a dance troupe, who aims to land a performing contract with the hotel owned by Giriprasad. However, things take a turn when Giriprasad falls in love with Priya.

title: Parambarai
desc: Paramasivan has a rocky relationship with his father following the tragic murder of his mother. To make matters more complicated, he falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless landlord.
